hooks.name: Evidence rules reminder for engineering edits
hooks.description: Reminds the agent of the evidence and honesty rules before writing engineering files.

action.prompt: If this edit touches engineering/, frontend/src/investigation/ or handoff/, check it against .kiro/steering/evidence-rules.md: cite registered source IDs, keep missing data null, never upgrade a cause from polygons or complaints alone, never attach 2018 barrier costs to drainage work, and keep mock data labelled.
